docs.summary: A clip whose per bone tracks are quantized: constant channels are stored once, changing ones are range quantized per frame. Plays like an [`AnimationClip`](#api~Prowl.Motion.AnimationClip) at a fraction of the memory.

members.name: GetPose
members.signature: public override void GetPose(FrameTime frameTime, Pose result, SkeletonMapping? mapping)

docs.summary: Samples the clip at a frame time into `result`. With a `mapping` the result is a pose of another skeleton, whose bones take the source bone of the same name and keep their reference pose when the clip has no bone for them.
